dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Whew... Finally, a chance to put our feet up. Meow!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Here, drink this. It's water with some salt and nectar in it. It makes a great recovery drink after intense exercise.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: The flavor is nicely balanced, with a touch of salt to offset the sweetness. Take a sip, and you'll feel a burst of energy, plus a boost to your mental clarity... Actually, you know what — forget all that. Just try it for yourself!
